prompt: Describe all the reasons that people on discord would use Do Not Disturb mode, and why people wouldn't use it.
response: Do Not Disturb mode on Discord is primarily for those who want to completely block out all notifications, similar to turning off your phone. It's an all-or-nothing feature, so if you enable it, you won’t receive any messages, which can be inconvenient if you want to stay connected. People avoid it because it's too restrictive and doesn't allow for selective notification preferences.
